messages:
Fern: Tiny celebration update: launch day went live and the first week hit 10k active users! :sparkles: Thank you everyone, absolutely brilliant.
Diego: WHOA. Thats huge. Marshmallow roast on the roof at sunset? :marshmallow:
Sasha: Also confetti poppers? low-risk indoor-friendly ones pls. 
Mira: Vote time: :one: marshmallow + mini-serenade, :two: pizza + sticker packs. React with :one: or :two:
ops-bot: FYI: Canary -> prod promoted at 19:00. No incidents reported. :white_check_mark:
Fern: If :one: wins by 4pm we do marshmallows + a 10-min open mic on the roof. Remote folks get a snack box + virtual serenade.
Diego: Ill bring the skewers and a tiny portable grill. Also a playlist of very questionable cover songs.
Sasha: Can someone make a short sign-up for open-mic slots? 2-min max so we dont get seven power ballads.
Mira: Heres a quick signup (fake link): https://tiny.example/10k-open-mic
Jordan: Love this. Quick 5-minute huddle at 3:30 for a shoutout and to say thank you. Ill drop by.
Diego: Marshmallow options: classic, dark-chocolate-dipped, and vegan. Add safe option notes pls.
Sasha: Ill handle popper safety and a tiny script to keep things short and sweet. Also bringing glow sticks.
Fern: Huge kudos to the infra and product teams for the late-night polish. Special callout to @Sasha for the last-minute telemetry fix.
Mira: Remote folks: DM me your addresses and well ship a snack box. Also well record the serenade for those in other timezones.
Diego: See you at sunset (rooftop). Bring your best off-key enthusiasm. :guitar:
Sasha: Tiny reminder: nothing flame-y indoors. Rooftop only. 
Fern: See everyone at 6:30pm. Thank you all again 60a
